$schema: T23 governance exceptions registry. dependencyExceptions: GR1 direction exceptions with reason + retireWhen. compatAllowlist: GR2 baseline of legacy/compat markers; pendingRemoval: true = shrink-only debt, false = permanent legitimate wording.

dependencyExceptions.reason: worker 复用 web 的 PostgreSQL pool/事件 adapter(AGENTS.md 承认的存储边界例外),避免两个进程各自维护一套连接与追加读实现
dependencyExceptions.retireWhen: 存储访问收敛为独立的 @ui4a/db 共享包后,worker 改从该包导入,本例外移除

dependencyExceptions.reason: delegation.kill.integration.test 直接构造 web engine service 验证 kill 证据落库,属测试期耦合
dependencyExceptions.retireWhen: kill 证据改为经公开契约(事件日志读取边界或 @ui4a/db)断言后移除

dependencyExceptions.reason: service.incremental/restart-replay 测试直接 import worker activities 做回放对比,属测试期耦合
dependencyExceptions.retireWhen: 回放对比改为消费 worker 公开导出或共享包后移除

dependencyExceptions.reason: presentation scenario 测试直接读取 apps/web 内置 walkthrough bundle JSON 作为 fixture
dependencyExceptions.retireWhen: fixture 移入 packages 自身测试资产或独立 fixtures 包后移除;packages 对 apps 的运行时依赖永远不允许
